push.title: W 4-2 vs El Chele | You: 9.4 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
A 9.4, BellyTb1. Your best match performance of the season. If the season had a highlight reel, you're the opening scene.

THE GOOD
+ 10 shots at El Chele's goal. You kept the keeper busier than a one-man band.
+ 1 key pass. Assists don't make headlines, but they make teams.
+ Man of the Match, your 10th for us. You set the bar, now the rest of us get to chase it.
+ You and PhogsToffees were on the same wavelength, like two radios tuned to the good station.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 4. Put that in the team scrapbook.

THE BAD
- 72% passing (13 of 18). Focus point: Pass to the far foot of a teammate who's facing play; it lets them take it forward in one touch. That's a coach's honest word.
- 5 of 10 shots on target. Between you and me: Look up before you shoot. Half a second tells you where the keeper's weight is. No sweat, just reps.
- You and buddskees both need a tune-up on shot selection. Do it together: cut it back to each other.
- 2 tackles won: -0.3. Next match, nail it.

Garden drill: If you're pressed from behind, play it back the way you're facing. Don't turn into trouble.

BellyTb1, something I want you to sleep on: Biscuits fix most things. Practice fixes the rest.

Celebrate, then sleep. - Coach Lasso

push.title: W 4-2 vs El Chele | You: 8.9 (best match performance of the season)
push.body:
PhogsToffees, that 8.9 is your best match performance of the season. I'm grinning like a possum eating persimmons.

THE GOOD
+ 90% passing on 29 attempts, up from your usual 83%. That's the kind of passing that tires the other team out.
+ 3 shots at El Chele's goal. You got into shooting spots again and again.
+ 1 assist (down from your usual 2). Chances like that are gifts. You were Santa out there.
+ You and BellyTb1 were finishing each other's sentences out there.
+ Relegation match survived: we stayed in Division 4. That one belongs to all of us, and you were in it.

THE BAD
- Key passes 0, down from your usual 2. Lesson of the day: Look for the third man: pass to the feet of the player who can find the runner.
- Lowest tackles attempted on the team: 1 (best was buddskees's 4). Start here: Know your runner before the cross comes in. A quick look over the shoulder saves a goal.
- Shots on target: 67%. Push for 90%+ and you're elite company.
- Passes attempted 29, from 35 in your previous match. Let's call that a lesson and not a trend.

Five-minute drill: Receive on the half-turn so your first touch can go forward.

PhogsToffees, from me to you: Taking on a challenge is a lot like riding a horse. Comfortable is overrated.

Tell your mama I said hi. - Coach Lasso

One thought for the road, buddskees: Good passes are like good manners. Free, and people remember.

I believe in you, period. - Coach Lasso
